chunks: Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Suwayd al-Qallāʾ, from Ayyūb ibn al-Ḥurr, from Abū Bakr al-Ḥaḍramī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: ʿAlqamah ibn Muḥammad made a bequest that I should free a slave on his behalf, so I freed a woman on his behalf. Will that suffice for him, or should I free one on his behalf from my own wealth?
He said: It suffices him. Then he said: Fāṭimah, the mother of my son, made a bequest that I should free a slave on her behalf, so I freed a woman on her behalf.

key_terms.أَوْصَى: made a bequest or final instruction
key_terms.أُعْتِقَ: that a slave be freed or manumitted
key_terms.امْرَأَةً: a female slave in this context
key_terms.يُجْزِيهِ: it is sufficient and fulfills the obligation

ai.seo_question: If someone bequeaths that a slave be freed on their behalf, does freeing a female slave fulfill the bequest?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a bequest for manumission: freeing a female slave fulfills a general instruction to free a slave. The Imam عليه السلام confirms the sufficiency of that act and supports the ruling by mentioning his own similar fulfillment of such a bequest.
